a.text: One hidden Spark. Where would you look?
a.phonemes: wˈʌn hˈɪdən spˈɑːɹk. wˌɛɹ wʊd juː lˈʊk?

b.text: Every hunt starts with a clue. Read it closely.
b.phonemes: ˈɛvɹi hˈʌnt stˈɑːɹts wɪð ɐ klˈuː. ɹˈiːd ɪt klˈoʊsli.

c.text: Follow the signal. Explore the workspaces. Get closer.
c.phonemes: fˈɑːloʊ ðə sˈɪɡnəl. ɛksplˈɔːɹ ðə wˈɜːkspeɪsᵻz. ɡɛt klˈoʊsɚ.

d.text: Found it. What could your hunt unlock?
d.phonemes: fˈaʊnd ɪt. wˌʌt kʊd jʊɹ hˈʌnt ʌnlˈɑːk?

ef.text: Your hunt could unlock an Amazon gift card. Eligibility and terms apply.
ef.phonemes: jʊɹ hˈʌnt kʊd ʌnlˈɑːk ɐn ˈæmɐzˌɑːn ɡˈɪft kˈɑːɹd. ˌɛlɪdʒəbˈɪlᵻɾi ænd tˈɜːmz ɐplˈaɪ.

g.text: Pick a city. Discover your next workspace.
g.phonemes: pˈɪk ɐ sˈɪɾi. dɪskˈʌvɚ jʊɹ nˈɛkst wˈɜːkspeɪs.

h.text: Where’s your Spark hiding? Enter the hunt.
h.phonemes: wˌɛɹz jʊɹ spˈɑːɹk hˈaɪdɪŋ? ˈɛntɚ ðə hˈʌnt.
